title: Driving Less
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / Driving less makes a difference

dialogue.t: Amy, do you go to school by car?
No. I walk or ride my bike.
Cars use oil and make the air dirty.
My father drives to work every day.
He can take the bus once a week.
That is a good idea. Driving less makes a big difference.
Yes. It is good for nature, and it is good for us too.

vocab: drive 驾驶 · oil 石油 · dirty 脏的 · difference 差别 · nature 自然 · bike 自行车
